key_findings: NKG2D ligands (Raet1e, Mult1) are induced by nerve injury in unmyelinated DRG neurons, enriched in Mrgprd+ non-peptidergic nociceptors and Trpv1-lineage neurons.
Soluble NKG2D bound injured human iPSC-derived sensory axons after laser ablation, and NKG2D blockade prevented NK cell-mediated neurite degeneration.
